name: custtoolset_pillar6_extractor
description: Analyzes third-party SuiteApps and Managed Bundles to inventory dependencies, detect code collisions on shared records, and quantify performance costs.

analysisType.description: The specific bundle analysis to execute. Use 'bundle_inventory' to list all installed packages, 'component_conflicts' to find overlapping scripts from different bundles on the same record, or 'performance_impact' to calculate governance consumption by bundle ID.

returns.description: A JSON payload containing bundle installation metadata, logic collision mappings, or aggregated governance usage by third-party publisher.
